pr.title: Color requests peach and put start first in their drawer
pr.head: 78c1ede708e34f16ff34195078310119a467bfc8

summary: Projector's panel sits above the Claude Code prompt and lists your pull requests and your inbox. The inbox holds three kinds of item that agents post: a question wants an answer, a notice wants a read, and a request asks you to do something only you can do, such as testing a build on your phone. Each open item's line has its own color, so you can tell the kinds apart at a glance. Opening an item shows its drawer under it, with numbered buttons you press by digit, by click, or by Enter.

This pull request fixes two problems with requests. First, a request's line used Claude Code's suggestion theme color, which every built-in theme draws in the same blue as a question's permission, so requests and questions looked alike. The request line is now a literal pastel peach, rgb(255,190,140). Second, a request with a start action (something the agent prepares before you begin, such as installing the build) offered start on 8, below Done and Declined. Start now comes first, on 1, with done and declined after it.
The review found one open problem: the peach is hard to read on Claude Code's light themes. The flag on hooks/register.tsx gives the measurements.

groups.title: The request line's color and the drawer's order
groups.kicker: What the panel draws for an open request
intro: REQUEST_COLOR is the color of an open request's line, and of the collapsed + N requests line. It changes from the theme key suggestion to a literal rgb(255,190,140), which Claude Code draws the same in every theme.

In the drawer, a new startOf helper decides whether the first button is start, retry, or absent. It returns start before you press it, retry once the agent reports it was blocked, and nothing while the agent works, once it is ready, or for a request without a start action. drawOutcomes draws that button on 1 and numbers done and declined after it. The old startLines, which put start among the actions on 8, is gone.

Pressing start still goes through act, which passes the start action the drawer shows as --action. The CLI refuses that with exit 65 when the agent has revised the action since, and the panel then reads the store again so the drawer shows the new one.

checks.text: Enter on a request's line moves the focus ring onto start:<ref>, or onto outcome:<ref>.done without a start action. A probe test run with claude plugin test . confirmed both; no test in the pull request covers it.

files.note: The request color, the new startOf, the reordered drawOutcomes, and the drawer's first focus target.

checks.text: On the light and light-daltonized themes, this peach has a contrast ratio of 1.42:1 against the panel's rgb(240,240,240). That is fainter than the 1.92:1 of subtle, the muted color of a resolved item, so an open request reads as more muted than items that need nothing. The review asks for a darker color on the light themes, chosen by theme as THEME_BACKGROUNDS chooses the background.
act is unchanged, so start and retry still pass the shown action and re-read the store on exit 65. The test of a press on a revised drawer still passes.

files.note: Updates the request tests for the peach color, the lowercase labels, and start and retry on 1 with done and declined on 2 and 3.
Describes the peach line and the new drawer order.
